reviews.text: Excellent choice, we went there on a recommendation and they are indeed professionals, Max gets impeccably clean every six weeks, he really seems like a different dog.

I've completed a 300-hour course and, after this great experience, I feel fully prepared to start my own business in this field. I'd like to thank all the staff, especially Antonio for his excellent service and Mónica, who is a fantastic teacher.

I wouldn't take my dogs anywhere else. They come out looking gorgeous and spotless, with their paws, ears, glands, etc., all meticulously cared for. And the price is very competitive.

I just finished the course at the Mónica Gómez dog grooming school. It was a highly practical training program, and I've gained a solid foundation to start in this profession that I love ✨. It's helped me gain confidence and experience working with dogs on a daily basis, and feel more prepared to start working 🙂. …

I recently completed a dog grooming course and the experience was excellent. I appreciated the personalized attention and teaching style, which made learning easier and more enjoyable. I'm leaving very happy and highly motivated to continue learning.
A highly professional center with a great atmosphere and quality hands-on training. Definitely a great choice for your training needs.

I just finished the course and I couldn't be happier. What I value most is the large amount of practical work we did from day one; I was able to work with many different breeds and coat types. Our instructor, Marta, is a highly skilled professional who teaches real-world techniques, not just theory.

I'm very happy with it and I definitely recommend it. It's a unique experience. I did it at the Donoso Cortes school with Marta, a very professional teacher who helps you with everything from the very beginning. It's a course where you're with a puppy from the first day and they teach you how to do things from the very first day. Thanks to Mónica Gómez and the whole team.

I took the dog grooming course, and I'm really happy with how it went. Marta is a true professional; she knows a lot about the trade and is always willing to answer our questions. The atmosphere at the grooming salon has always been very pleasant, both because of the other students and the location itself, which is in a very quiet neighborhood. The salon space is spacious and bright. They teach all kinds of breeds, coat types, and techniques. You leave the course having learned and practiced everything you need. If you've made the most of the course, you'll leave with enough confidence to continue practicing dog grooming professionally.

If I had to do it again, I would definitely choose this school and Marta again.

First time here and everything was great. The service was impeccable and our poodle's haircut was excellent. The managers and the rest of the staff were very professional and lovely.
Thank you and see you next time!

The dog grooming course offers comprehensive, hands-on training for those who want to learn how to care for the appearance and well-being of dogs. Throughout the course, students learn bathing techniques, breed-specific haircuts, tool handling, and skin and coat care, always prioritizing the animal's safety and respectful treatment. It's an excellent option for both beginners and those seeking professional development, as it combines theoretical knowledge with real-world practice and prepares students to work confidently in the field.
They really are the best groomers. They are so kind to animals.

I attended two centers in Madrid (Moncloa and Alonso Cano), completing around 80 hours out of a total of 300. Dropping out of a course at this price is not something one does lightly. After that time, I realized that continuing wouldn't provide me with the necessary learning to practice this profession, so I feel it's important to share my experience.

The instructors have extensive professional experience; however, the teaching method is poorly structured. Often, the explanations are vague or overly general, and during practical sessions, I missed having real and consistent support.

Theoretical material: the book provided by the school is not very useful, as it is limited to brief lists and superficial descriptions, without delving into the fundamentals that give meaning to the practice.

Support during practice: in class, many techniques were taught only with "what to do" instructions, without explaining the reason for the movements or their actual effect. This leads to students performing actions without understanding their impact. Understanding the process is as important as executing it, and without this explanation, insecurity arises and the correct application of the technique in the future becomes difficult.

In most cases, the instructors finished the assignments without simultaneously explaining the procedure, the criteria, or the decisions made. This occurred regardless of how long the student had been in the course and limited real-world practice. Sometimes, the assignments were even finished 30-45 minutes before the end of class, leaving extra time that the student could have used to practice and consolidate the technique independently. Learning solely through observation is not enough to develop autonomy, nor does it replace guided instruction.

On several occasions, the feedback was abrupt or lacked pedagogical approach, which generated insecurity and hindered learning.

Although the center defends its style as "direct and professional, similar to a real work environment," the reality is that this approach is uncomfortable and creates an unnecessary level of pressure in a training context. It's possible to be demanding and train students properly without creating stress or confusion.

During my time there, I spoke with other students who had already completed the training. When asked if they felt prepared to work, they all answered no. This clearly demonstrates that, even if certain knowledge is acquired, the training doesn't guarantee that the student can perform confidently or complete a job without the assistance of a more qualified person.

The overall feeling during the training is closer to being a mere laborer than being in a learning environment.

For all these reasons, I don't recommend this school for those seeking a solid education, and I believe this is important information to consider before making such a significant financial investment.
Thank you so much. I encourage everyone who loves animals to study this profession at the best school in Madrid.

At first, I decided to take my course with Mónica because they promised it would be practical from the very beginning.

And boy, was it ever! I've put in 300 hours of practical training, all hands-on with scissors and direct contact with tons of dogs of all different breeds (and a couple of cats too 🤔), and it's been fantastic.

I 100% recommend the school, as long as you're really sure about what you're getting into, because people don't seem to understand that this work is hard, physically demanding, and requires a lot of patience. Not all dogs behave the way we'd like, and you have to keep that in mind at all times (TikTok has done a lot of damage).

I've learned so much about dog behavior and handling, acquired many skills with different tools, and am leaving with a wealth of knowledge I won't forget for my future career (sculpting scissors and Spanish Water Dogs don't mix 😂).

I'm so grateful to the whole team: Mónica, María, Raquel, and Antonio. Thank you for your patience, professionalism, effort, and for continuing to be a support network even after the course has ended.

I'm sure that's something many other courses don't offer after you finish.

Thank you so much, and we'll stay in touch! ❤️😄

Nuria.

My experience at the Mónica Gómez Dog Grooming School has been excellent. The classes with Marta have been very comprehensive: she explains clearly, conveys passion for her work, and makes sure everyone fully understands each topic. I've learned a lot and gained confidence handling dogs. I wholeheartedly recommend both the school and Marta for their professionalism and the quality of their training.

I just finished the course at Donoso Cortes with Marta and I'm very happy with the classes and the teacher. And thanks also to Mónica Gómez for giving me this opportunity to discover this wonderful world.

Delighted with the course I took at Mónica Gómez's school.

Thanks to Marta from Topknot, a fantastic teacher and professional, who shares all her experience, knowledge of grooming, and techniques—a great combination that makes this course the perfect choice.

From day one, you're putting everything into practice with all kinds of breeds, which is how you truly learn.

Thanks for everything, Marta and Santi!

Hugs!

I just finished Mónica Gómez's course at the Donoso Cortés school with Marta, and I loved it—it was incredibly comprehensive and practical. I would recommend it a thousand times over. Thanks also to the Alonso Cano school and the professionals they have on staff to help you choose the right materials.
Excellent service. Very professional.

It's undoubtedly the best place to study and train in this field. From day one, you're working with a dog, and throughout the course, you'll see countless breeds and techniques. The teachers are fantastic: María and Mónica, and of course, Raquel and Antonio, who manage everything flawlessly.

They're all wonderful. It's tough at first, but it's totally worth it and will help you enter this job market in the future. Plus, you quickly bond with your classmates. I encourage anyone who wants to be a dog groomer to study here!

I'd been wanting to try dog ​​grooming for a while, and I finally decided to train with Mónica Gómez.

I went to the Alonso Cano school and took the 300-hour course. I highly recommend it if you're starting from scratch, like I did. From the very first minute, you have a dog in front of you, and it's all hands-on practice with real-life, everyday cases while you learn the theory.

To be honest, for a beginner, it can be tough because it's not easy, but it's also very rewarding to see yourself improving and learning in every class. Attitude is everything!

Many thanks to the entire team at this school.

To Mónica and María, the teachers, for their instruction and their constant patience with me.

To Raquel and Antonio for their helpfulness and guidance, both with the materials and the extra training. (I highly recommend the first aid workshop! It's essential for complementing your grooming skills.)

To my classmates, with whom I learned side-by-side. I also gained valuable lessons and some new connections from you all.

And to Patricia, for managing everything and making it easy for me to get everything ready so I could start the course.

I came out of curiosity, but I found something I really like. I'll continue learning, working, and growing. Thank you for everything!

Ana

Wonderful professionals! They made my toy poodle, Pipa, feel like a princess, and she left so happy.
Thank you so much!

A very unpleasant experience...

It's normal that you want to defend your reputation, but as far as I'm concerned, I haven't said anything untrue... I don't know how you think you value someone by ignoring them all the time and siding with a student... For my part, I received hostile treatment from the moment I started, but of course, you're not going to publish that, it's obvious... Mónica and María are true professionals, very approachable, with a wealth of experience, and always willing to help you with anything. You can tell they love what they do, and it shows in every class.

The course is very hands-on, which means you really learn, as if you were already working in a hair salon.

I felt very comfortable and learned so much. Thank you for everything!

Thanks also to Santi, who was always ready to help, and to the group of students I met during the course.
Everything was outstanding. I learned so much.
I'm going to miss you all!

Antonio and Raquel guide you on equipment and if you want to open your own grooming salon, and they're very encouraging on those days when you're undecided. It started as a course, but in the end, it feels like a family. I'm leaving very happy and I'll miss them a lot.

I've wanted to train as a dog groomer for a long time, and I couldn't have found a better school! 🥰 I started from scratch and I'm leaving so happy after everything I've learned thanks to my teacher, Marta. 😊 Besides that, the materials they provide are excellent and in great condition, which is so appreciated!

I'm leaving full of enthusiasm and eager to start working professionally. 🐶✨✂️🤩

In my case, I took an advanced course and learned and refined quite a few things. Both Mónica and Maria are incredible teachers; there's a great atmosphere and you feel right at home. I recommend it without hesitation. We miss you all, amazing team! Hugs

Everything has been wonderful with these professionals in the dog grooming sector, Mónica, María... I'm currently about to finish my 300-hour course at the Moncloa school with Marta, an exceptional teacher. I'm very happy with the learning; it's practical and independent (with supervision 😉) from the very first minute. Yesterday, I had the pleasure of taking the first aid course taught by the veterinary director, Carlota, at the school itself, and I couldn't have left happier and better informed about how to react to any medical emergency. Antonio and Raquel advised me today on how to set up a business and showed me all the equipment they have available, and I was delighted with that too.
So, if you want to train in this sector, don't waste your time looking elsewhere, THIS IS YOUR SCHOOL.
THANK YOU ALL FOR EVERYTHING
María Serradilla

I finished the training a few days ago and already have job offers thanks to their internal job placement service and all the advice they gave me on what equipment to buy for my future.

Thanks also to Antonio and Raquel for their dedication and help.
They are passionate about the industry, and it shows. I will always be grateful!
Thank you for your feedback :)
